skills.name: dev-setup
skills.description: How to install, build and run the project's check on a fresh machine
skills.why: the checkout has package.json and docker-compose.yml and no setup skill yet
skills.body:
# Dev setup for demo-app

Use this on a fresh clone or when a build fails for reasons that look environmental.

1. Read the recorded environment first: `pulse env show --project demo-app` prints the toolchain versions and the install recipe the project keeps; prefer it to guessing.
2. Install with npm: `npm ci`.
3. Run the project's check: `npm test`; it is what `pulse` runs before a landing, so a red one blocks.
4. Services come from `docker-compose.yml`: `docker compose up -d` before the check, `docker compose down` after.

When a step fails on the environment and not the code, fix the environment, then record what you learned with `pulse env` so the next agent starts further along.

Written by PULSE from the project's shape; edit it as the project changes.
skills.add: pulse skill add --name dev-setup --project demo-app --description 'How to install, build and run the project'"'"'s check on a fresh machine' --file dev-setup.md

skills.name: ui-check
skills.description: How to look at UI work before calling it done
skills.why: the checkout has a web UI (nextjs) and no UI check skill yet
skills.body:
# UI check for demo-app

UI work is not done until someone has looked at it. Do this before the last commit of any change that touches a page, a component or a stylesheet.

1. Serve it: `npm run dev (or `npm run build && npx serve out` for a static export)`.
2. Screenshot it headless: `npx -y playwright screenshot --viewport-size 1280,900 --wait-for-timeout 2000 http://127.0.0.1:PORT/ check.png` (a playwright tool connection makes this a tool call; `pulse toolkit` suggests it).
3. Look at the screenshot: layout, spacing, text that overflows, states that are empty or loading. Take one in light and one in dark when the app has both.
4. Read the browser console; a new error or warning is part of the change.
5. Keep the screenshot out of the commit unless the project keeps them on purpose; mention what you saw in the handoff.

User interface: nextjs.

Written by PULSE from the project's shape; edit it as the project changes.
skills.add: pulse skill add --name ui-check --project demo-app --description 'How to look at UI work before calling it done' --file ui-check.md
